title: Objective Vision
features:
Objective Vision+ helps you instantly see all interactable objects around you.
No more searching. No more guessing.
Items that can be interacted with are automatically highlighted with clean outlines and distance labels, so you always know what matters right now.

FEATURES
• Highlights all ProximityPrompt objects
• Shows item name + real stud distance
• Smart color system
• Green = single-use (loot, keys, collectibles)
• Yellow = reusable (doors, buttons, NPCs)
• Single-use items disappear after pickup
• Toggle ON/OFF anytime (L key or GUI button)
• Draggable minimalist UI
• Lightweight & smooth performance
• Works in most games

Perfect for scavenger hunts, quests, and objective-based games.
Simple • Clean • Smart
